transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to get the pre-opening review of the Scene Remix installation wrapped up so I can finalize approval. We've got the draft operating plan in front of us — six-minute sessions, portrait photos and video capture, a 1.2-meter queue lane in the main lobby, and email collection from each participant. Before I sign off, I need to hear from legal, accessibility, and audience-experience on any required changes. Who'd like to start?
